title: Glimmerati
statusNote: N-Gage logo, animated intro, main menu, character name, Story Mode: the Davina de Luxa Show and the Monaco cutscenes play, then car selection and the first race in Milan drives (top-down 3D, speedometer, radar, map on 9, pause menu).
notes: A new game first asks for a character name; type it on the number keys like a phone (2 gives a), then press OK.
Story scenes show Continue and Skip on the soft keys. On the grid, press 5 to start the race.

The multiplayer race (Bluetooth) works between two players in one room: the host chooses Host Game and then Player Setup, the other Join Game and the host in the list; the host then chooses Launch Game, both pick a car, and the host presses 5 on the grid. N-Gage Arena is no longer online.

multiplayer.menu: Start Game > Multiplayer Race > Host Game / Join Game
multiplayer.statusNote: Two players in one room: one hosts and opens Player Setup, the other joins and picks the host from the list, the host chooses Launch Game and both pick a car; a race in Milan ran on both screens, each sees the other's car under its name in the room, one player's pause is shown to the other, and the host's race is cancelled when the other quits. More than two players were not tried.

controls.source: The game's defaults from Options > Control Settings (the game can change them there). Accelerating, steering, the map, the soft keys and the pause menu were confirmed in a race.

actions.lsk: Select or Continue (menus and scenes); pause (in a race)
actions.rsk: Back, Skip or Cancel; Resume (pause menu)
actions.5: Accelerate; start the race on the grid

notes: Racing layout: steer on the arrows, A accelerates, Z brakes, Space fires the nitro, M shows the map, Escape pauses. The digit row still types the keypad, which the name entry needs.
On a gamepad the right trigger or X accelerates, the left trigger or Y brakes, B fires the nitro, the right shoulder shows the map, Start pauses.
